messages:
matt: Heads-up — deploybot just applied a soft-throttle on rollout v3.7.0 (traffic tilt back to 20%). telemetry shows p95 latency +42% on embeddings route. thinking: let it stabilize for 15m or manual cutover/rollback. anyone on-call for an ops decision?

deploy-bot: [automated] Throttle applied to rollout v3.7.0. Current traffic: 20%. Reason: embeddings_p95_delta >= 40% over 5m. Suggested actions: 
- wait 15m (monitor)
- manual rollback to v3.6.2 (/deploy rollback)
- pin v3.6.2 for affected customers

sara: @matt thanks — i'm looking at the traces now. errors are not rising, it's pure latency on kv hotpath. probably kernel/quant change. i vote hold 10-15m and watch.

ops-oncall: i'm available. if p95 doesn't trend down in 10m we should do a manual rollback. prefer partial rollback for embeddings route only if we can patch routing quickly.

emily: can we do a quick canary rollback for /embeddings only? routing config is in infra-traffic, i can cut a route split in ~6m.

jordan: +1 to emily. also prepare release-note blurb for customers: "performance regression observed, temporary traffic reduction applied, full rollback planned if not resolved." i'll draft. :pencil2:

matt: ok plan: emily, start route split and prepare to pin to v3.6.2; ops-oncall, be ready to run rollback if p95 stays >30% above baseline at t+15m; sara and i will keep monitoring telemetry and traces. deploy-bot: hold off autorevert for now (manual only).

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator request. Autorevert window: disabled until 4332110700.

emily: routing split staged: 80% -> v3.7.0, 20% -> v3.6.2 for /embeddings. checking logs to ensure no 5xx gap.

sara: monitoring: p95 moved from +42% -> +35% since route split, still above threshold but trending down. no error spike.

ops-oncall: holding until t+15m (4332110776). if p95 > +30% then execute: ```/deploy rollback --service embeddings --to v3.6.2 --reason "latency regression"```

matt: agreed. jordan, include this in the release notes: mention targeted rollback option and customer-facing mitigation.

jordan: done — short note posted in #product-updates draft. cc legal for wording. :white_check_mark:

emily: route split complete and verified. no immediate regressions. keeping eyes on tail latencies.

sara: t+12m now, p95 at +28% baseline. ops-oncall, still ok to hold?

ops-oncall: hold. continuing to monitor. if by t+20m not under +20% we rollback.

matt: thanks all. will update cust comms if we roll. otherwise we plan to ramp back up gradually after 30m stable. :thumbsup:
